lightingUpgrades.shadowFrustum: Dynamic tight ±6.2m following active focal point
lightingUpgrades.undergroundCutawayLights: Dedicated cool-teal aquifer caustic fill + warm metallic bit/pipe rim light
lightingUpgrades.contactShadows: Soft radial AO decals beneath every character foot, bucket, house, rig outrigger, lab bottle, and water tank

scientificAccuracyRules: Aquifer is depicted STRICTLY as porous saturated sand/gravel and fractured rock interstices — NEVER an empty underground river cave.
Geophysical survey visualizes interpreted resistivity lines & subsurface layers — NEVER a magical direct X-ray water camera.
Drilling depth meter shows progressive relative depth indicator — NO universal fixed depth number.
Well construction keeps ONE consistent vertical borehole cross-section for Casing, Screen, Gravel Pack, and Sanitary Seal.
Water clearing during development is explicitly NOT portrayed as proof of drinking safety — laboratory parameter testing (pH, TDS, Kekeruhan, Mikrobiologi) follows.
Closing emphasizes sustainable extraction vs rainfall recharge balance.
